“Psychotic break seems to be the new excuse for murder.”

@NancyGrace weighs in on the Lindsay Clancy case with @seanhannity, arguing there will be a retrial after the Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three young children was found not guilty by reason of insanity. htt

.@HARRISFAULKNER zeroes in on one detail from Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s 9/11 executive order signing: He gives the ceremonial pen to NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch and asks her to pass it to chief counsel Ramzi Kassem.

“Because it sends the signal,” Faulkner tells @seanhannity, ht
